name: What information should I prepare for an ADU feasibility consultation?

mainEntity.name: What information should I prepare for an ADU feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To get the most out of your consultation, prepare your property address, any existing site plans or surveys, and a general idea of your goals for the ADU (e.g., rental income, family use, size preferences). Having these documents and ideas ready can help streamline the assessment of your property in areas like San Leandro or Hayward.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your property address, existing site plans, and ADU goals to streamline the consultation.
